Dass Metals Products Toronto, manufacture commercial residential & industrial steel studs & tracks for the GTA. Dass Metal Studs are built with quality and safety in mind while meeting local building codes in Toronto. Our light gauge steel studs & heavy gauge steel studs are precisely made to fit all your construction needs. We can also customize our steel studs product packages to meet each individual project’s requirements in Toronto. Steel structural studs are modern commercial and residential building materials used specifically to frame and support interior and exterior walls.

Also, full manufacturer support for all technical and engineering aspects of steel Studs & track is provided by us. Dass Metal Studs carries one of the largest inventories of all types of steel Studs & tracks in the Toronto market. Available in a range of lengths and thicknesses ranging from 16 to 25 gauge, the smaller the number the thicker the steel.

Toronto’s Leading Manufacturer of All Types Steel Studs & Track for Construction Industries

Steel Studs available on Special order in Toronto for construction job full manufacturer support. Dass Metal Studs is also a leading manufacturer & supplier of quality steel products in the Toronto area. One-stop shop in Toronto for steel studs & tracks for commercials & residential construction project. We manufacture from 12 to 25 gauge & track an excellent building choice for both commercial and residential construction. Our branches serve construction projects of all sizes across the Toronto Canada year-round.

  • 25 gauge Steel studs and track
  • 20 gauge Steel studs and track
  • 18 gauge Steel studs and track
  • 16 gauge Steel studs and track
  • 14 gauge Steel studs and track
  • 12 gauge Steel studs and track
